Common outpatient E/M lookup; useful for physician productivity content.

prioritized_roadmap.item: Appendectomy + lap chole + abscess/open abdomen hub cluster
prioritized_roadmap.why: High-volume procedure-name searches plus strong completed CPT coverage.
Broad evergreen search intent; directly improves surgeon documentation behavior.

prioritized_roadmap.item: Emergency general surgery and damage-control surgery hubs
prioritized_roadmap.why: Lower volume than appy/chole but strong topical authority and professional relevance.

prioritized_roadmap.item: Internal links from CPT pages to hubs and coding centers
prioritized_roadmap.why: Moves users from single-code lookup into multi-page sessions.

prioritized_roadmap.item: Analytics export pipeline for GA4/Search Console + search/case events
prioritized_roadmap.why: Not directly indexable, but stops us from guessing priorities.

prioritized_roadmap.item: Future CPT audits: Breast, Soft Tissue, Endocrine
prioritized_roadmap.why: Coverage gains matter, but content/hub acquisition is likely the larger near-term traffic lever after 88.4% General Surgery coverage.

strategic_recommendation: Near-term growth is more likely to come from content hubs, internal linking, and analytics-driven user acquisition than from additional CPT coverage alone. Coverage is now strong enough in core General Surgery to support SEO authority; the bottleneck is targeted content and telemetry.
